title: Question 26
passage:
Could you move the pie from the windowsill to the counter?
A. The window was open all afternoon. B. I bought the apples at the market. C. I will clear some space on the counter first.
passageZh:
能請你把派從窗臺移到檯面上嗎？
A. 窗戶整個下午都開著。 B. 蘋果是在市場買的。 C. 我會先把檯面清出一些空間。
